script_text: Here's your week, Libra, and it hits different. Early week, the Sun in your 10th House of career forms a sextile to Jupiter in your 7th House of partnerships on Tuesday — ambition and connection align beautifully. Monday brings Venus square Pluto stirring hidden tensions in love, so tread carefully. Wednesday marks your turning point: a New Moon in Taurus activates your 10th House of reputation, planting seeds for a major career breakthrough. Thursday through Sunday, your ruling planet Venus trines Neptune in your 9th House, flooding your romantic sector with idealism and creative inspiration. This weekend favors artistic expression or deepening a love bond. Tuesday is your power day because the Sun-Jupiter sextile supercharges your public image through collaboration. Monday is your worst day because Venus square Pluto unearths control dynamics in relationships. My advice: channel Tuesday's energy and pitch your boldest idea to the right person. Follow for daily updates.
